vo: Code Formatter. Open a code file, and it formats itself.
Raw JSON from an API is one long line that nobody can read.
With Code Formatter, it's clean and colored the moment the tab opens. No button to press.
Every object and array has its own fold arrow. Collapse everything, then open only what you need.
Click any value to see its path, and copy it with one click.
Switch to the original text at any time, or copy and download the file.
It follows your device. Light by day, dark by night.
CSS and JavaScript are formatted too, and fifteen more languages get syntax colors.
Everything runs in your browser. No account, and no tracking.
Code Formatter. Free on the Chrome Web Store.
title: Open a code file.
It formats itself.
en.end: Free on the Chrome Web Store

Wechseln Sie jederzeit zum Originaltext, oder kopieren Sie die Datei und laden Sie sie herunter.

Alles läuft in Ihrem Browser. Kein Konto und kein Tracking.
Code Formatter. Kostenlos im Chrome Web Store.
